reviewContext.userProblem: (#520) GET /v1/tickets?updatedAtStart=2026-10-28T04:08:57.101584+00:00 returns 400 because kftime.ParseInput switches on fixed string lengths and rejects valid RFC 3339 date-times with other fractional digit counts. (#523) POST /admin/api/workflows returns 404, so Argus tests cannot add a workflow definition to a running punchflow without restarting with a modified fixture.
requiredOutcomes: kftime.ParseInput accepts RFC 3339 date-time with 0-9 fractional digits and Z or +hh:mm/-hh:mm offset, plus date-only YYYY-MM-DD (JST midnight); everything else is rejected and QueryTime returns 400 invalid_parameter 'Invalid <key>'

POST /admin/api/workflows (createWorkflow) adds one fixture-shaped workflow to the running store: 201 WorkflowDetail; 401/403 auth; 400 invalid (fixture validator problems via baseline multiset diff); 409 duplicate id or code; visible via /v1/workflows and usable for POST /v1/tickets
README.md documents the RFC 3339 filter behavior and the new admin endpoint
go build ./..., go vet ./... and go test ./... pass at reconcile
nonGoals: No GET /admin/api/workflows and no DELETE /admin/api/workflows/{id} (design D8)
No change to kftime.Format/FormatDate/ToMillis/FromMillis output (still millisecond JST)
No change to internal/fixtures validator, internal/store, internal/present, internal/api/v1 production code, internal/httpx/query.go
No change to body date parsing (proxies, general masters, user custom fields) or internal/formula
constraints: Do not modify unrelated files; each worker touches only its plan's writePaths
Follow CLAUDE.md and go-coding-standards; split any touched Go file of 1000+ lines
No git write operations by workers; per-edit sha256 drift protocol
Commit messages contain no AI tool attribution or Co-Authored-By lines
Work on main of tacogips/punchflow; push to origin allowed
Workspace-wide go build/vet/test gate runs only in serial reconcile

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: ParseInput uses an anchored RFC 3339 regexp gate then time.RFC3339Nano; date-only stays JST midnight
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: time.Parse alone is more lenient than RFC 3339 (comma fraction, etc.); design-api-coverage.md#timestamp-input-parsing-argus-520

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Keep full precision in ParseInput; store.Millis truncates downstream
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Filters compare at stored millisecond precision; output formatting unchanged

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: createWorkflow validation = multiset difference of fixtures.Validate problems (File, Path, Message) between baseline export and export with candidate appended last
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: DR-001: candidate problems surface in several path forms and other files; pre-existing runtime problems must not block the request

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Duplicate id/code check against workflows rows of any status runs before validation and returns 409 conflict
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Distinguishes conflict from fixture validator 'duplicate id' 400s; unique-constraint insert failure maps to same 409

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: All steps after auth inside one WithTx; audit workflow.create in same tx; folder-scope 403 via Principal.AllowsAny
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Rejections leave no row and no audit; matches other admin mutations
GET duplicates /v1/workflows; DELETE needs ticket-reference rules; not required by #523

intentionalTradeoffs: Three independent wave-1 plans with disjoint write paths; README documents the design contract in parallel with code
PLAN-520 and PLAN-523 both run go test in internal/api/v1 during the wave; transient compile failure from the sibling's in-progress file is handled by rerun, never by editing it
Detail (slip) 11-validation limit test is optional under the design's 'or' wording; the 51-form limit test and slip combinationType test are required
supportedEdgeCases: Rejected: lowercase t/z, space separator, missing offset, comma fraction, 10+ digits, bare 'T56.Z', +0900, month 13, hour 24, trailing text, empty, garbage
createWorkflow without id generates UUID v4
Candidate id colliding with a later-file entity (tokens.json) or earlier entity (users.json) -> 400 duplicate id
Unrelated baseline validation problem (webhook with dangling workflow_ids) does not block a valid candidate
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Body date-time fields (none parse via ParseInput)
Deleting or listing runtime-created workflows via admin API
Supplying dependent definitions (folders, routes, categories) in the createWorkflow body

acceptanceCriteria: ParseInput uses the anchored regexp gate plus time.RFC3339Nano; date-only still JST midnight
All listed kftime accept/reject cases exist and pass, including nanosecond precision assertions
QueryTime 400 invalid_parameter test exists and passes
gofmt -l clean for owned files; kftime.Format output unchanged
createWorkflow POST /admin/api/workflows registered; routes_test.go expects 24 operations including it
Design steps 1-7 implemented in internal/admin/workflows.go with baseline multiset-diff validation, 409 before validation, folder-scope 403, audit inside WithTx
All listed tests pass: 201 + /v1 visibility + ticket creation, 401, 403, 400 cases, 409 cases, no row/audit after rejections, unrelated-state tolerance
gofmt -l clean and go vet passes for internal/admin; internal/fixtures unchanged
README has the RFC 3339 filter note in 'Point a kickflow client at punchflow'
README has '## Adding a workflow at runtime' after '## Webhooks' with the curl example and design link
No claim of GET or DELETE admin workflow endpoints
